description: This file defines a React functional component 'Column' for a Kanban board UI. It manages rendering a column with editable title, delete functionality, and display of cards. It interacts with context providers for Kanban state and feedback, and includes modal dialogs for delete confirmation.

methods.name: validateNewTitle(str)
methods.description: Validates that the new title is non-empty, differs from current, and optionally other checks.

methods.name: triggerTitleEdit
methods.description: Initiates inline editing of the column title, resetting input value.

methods.name: saveEditTitle
methods.description: Validates and saves the new column title; handles errors and updates state.

methods.name: handleTitleInputKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard events in the title input, saving on Enter or cancelling on Escape.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Triggers display of delete confirmation modal.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Performs deletion of the column and shows success toast.

methods.name: Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })

ctags.name: Column
ctags.pattern: /^function Column({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ column, index, isDragging, isOver, filteredCards, isCompact })
